fields.why: Infant (<6 months) hospitalization rates are compared by RR with every other age group ('higher than any other age group except adults aged >=75'), and Figure 2 shows maternal vaccination by infant age group.
Race/ethnicity and sex appear only as Table composition with no test or per-group outcome (rule 6).

Age-group RRs are each against infants <6 months (per-group vs referent); Figure 2's infant age groups are only shown with CIs. Mechanical flag is a false alarm: Fisher's test is the 2-season contrast and Wilcoxon compares continuous age between 2 maternal-vaccination groups, neither across 3+ age groups.

brief_issues: Figure 2's age groups are not enumerated in the packet (image only), so A's n_groups 3 is assumed from the Table's age bands; it does not affect the three fields.
